title: Business crime search taxonomy (SEC/DOJ/FBI typology fixtures)
note: Hard-coded business-crime categories and high-profile case typologies for company scan documentation. Not a live DOJ/SEC/FBI feed and not mass surveillance of U.S. businesses. Used by the Black-owned scan bot and tracker to search/document violation typologies against scanned companies (fixture rehearsal).
